description: This file contains high-level methods for trigger management in engine control software, including signal handling, event registration, noise filtering, and configuration change detection.

classes.name: TriggerCentral
classes.description: Main class managing trigger events, signal filtering, and state management in engine control.

methods.name: TriggerCentral::resetAccumSignalData
methods.description: Resets signal timing and period accumulators.

methods.name: TriggerCentral::getHwEventCounter
methods.description: Returns the hardware event counter at a specified index.

methods.name: TriggerCentral::addEventListener
methods.description: Registers a callback for trigger events.

methods.name: addTriggerEventListener
methods.description: Adds a trigger event listener to the engine's trigger central.

methods.name: TriggerCentral::noiseFilter
methods.description: Filters noise spikes in trigger signals based on accumulated periods.

methods.name: TriggerCentral::handleShaftSignal
methods.description: Processes shaft trigger signals, updates trigger state, and invokes listeners.

methods.name: resetRunningTriggerCounters
methods.description: Resets trigger counters and outputs trigger info.

methods.name: onConfigurationChangeTriggerCallback
methods.description: Handles updates when trigger configuration changes.

methods.name: checkIfTriggerConfigChanged
methods.description: Checks if trigger configuration has changed since last check.

methods.name: readIfTriggerConfigChangedForUnitTest
methods.description: Returns trigger configuration change status for unit testing.

methods.name: initTriggerCentral
methods.description: Initializes trigger central with logger and sets up actions.
